title: Passwordless sign-in via emailed single-use magic link
description: The application authenticates operators through a passwordless sign-in flow: the operator submits their email address to a POST /login endpoint; the server, when the address is a registered principal, mints a single-use token, composes a sign-in URL carrying that token, and sends the URL to the address via the configured email delivery adapter; the operator clicks the URL and lands on GET /login/verify, which consumes the token and issues a server-side session. No password field exists anywhere on the surface.
rationale: Passwords are a persistent liability: they leak, they get reused, they force the project into hashing, rotation, and reset flows that add surface without adding safety. A magic-link flow removes the credential the operator must remember, keeps the secret material server-owned and short-lived, and fits a single-deployable rcf-lite project without an external identity provider.
